title: Large Language Models for Agent-Based Modelling: Current and possible uses across the modelling cycle
abstract: arXiv:2507.05723v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) with increasingly sophisticated natural language understanding and generative capabilities has sparked interest in the Agent-based Modelling (ABM) community. With their ability to summarize, generate, analyze, categorize, transcribe and translate text, answer questions, propose explanations, sustain dialogue, extract information from unstructured text, and perform logical reasoning and problem-solving tasks, LLMs have a good potential to contribute to the modelling process. After reviewing the current use of LLMs in ABM, this study reflects on the opportunities and challenges of the potential use of LLMs in ABM. It does so by following the modelling cycle, from problem formulation to documentation and communication of model results, and holding a critical stance.

translated_title: 用于基于主体建模的大语言模型：建模周期中的现有与潜在应用
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）凭借日益成熟的自然语言理解与生成能力，引发了基于主体建模（ABM）领域的关注。由于其具备总结、生成、分析、分类、转录和翻译文本、回答问题、提出解释、维持对话、从非结构化文本中提取信息以及执行逻辑推理和问题解决任务的能力，大语言模型在建模过程中具有良好的应用潜力。本研究在回顾了大语言模型在基于主体建模中现有应用的基础上，对大语言模型在该领域潜在应用的机遇与挑战进行了反思。该研究沿着建模周期展开，涵盖从问题构建到模型结果的记录与传播的全过程，并始终保持批判性立场。
tldr: 本研究回顾了大语言模型在基于主体建模中的现有应用，并沿着从问题构建到结果传播的完整建模周期，批判性地分析了其潜在应用的机遇与挑战。
en_tdlr: This study reviews the current uses of Large Language Models in Agent-Based Modelling and critically examines the opportunities and challenges of their potential applications across the entire modelling cycle, from problem formulation to the documentation and communication of model results.
